messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick check-in 1: we need to finalize a short handbook update that clarifies 'manager-approved remote exceptions' and create a manager completion tracker for a 10-minute compliance micro-training. Looking for: 2 reviewers for wording + 1 person to run RSVP + completion tracking.

Owen: I can review wording this afternoon. timeline?

Maya (People Ops): Thanks Owen. Publish target 2026-04-20. Reviews due by 2026-04-03 so localization/legal have time. Training windows: 2026-04-13 & 2026-04-20.

Priya (Compliance): I'll audit the language for APAC and EU differences. Quick note: don't use phrasing that sounds like an entitlement for contractors.

Luis: I can own the tracker and send completion receipts. please confirm CSV header.

Maya (People Ops): CSV header to use (exact order):
manager_name,team,email,completed(yes/no),completion_ts,training_session,verifier,notes
We rely on that order for automations.

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled 10 days before first session and a follow-up nudge 48 hours after RSVP if completion isn't marked.

Owen: wording pass done 12 inline suggestions. I renamed the section to "Manager-authorized remote exceptions" and added a one-line example about short-term overlap during on-call handoffs.

Priya (Compliance): Suggest adding a clause: "Managers must document approval reason and expected duration" for DE/FR localization. I'll add recommended language.

Maya (People Ops): Perfect. Action items: 1) Owen finalize wording by 2026-04-02; 2) Priya legal/localization check by 2026-04-04; 3) Luis build tracker + send receipts by 2026-04-06; 4) Maya publish policy 2026-04-20 and run training. I'll post the PR link once opened.

Luis: I'll seed the tracker with managers from eng/product and share the sheet later today.

Maya (People Ops): PR opened: https://git.company/handbook/policies/manager-remote-exceptions-2026. Please add quick reviews.

PeopleOpsBot: Note: managers must enter rows using the exact CSV header ordering to ensure exports/SLAs work.
